Tung Tung Tung Survival has touched me deeply. It's mind bogglingly beautiful graphics have left me utterly speechless. The titular character — Tung Tung Tung Sahur — isn't just another horror monster—he's out for blood. However the genius developers of this amazing game have thought of a brilliant solution. When Tung Tung Tung Sahur approaches, you can stun him with blue light from your flash light. This idea isn't just smart— it's revolutionary, and honestly? That deserves 5 stars alone. Not to mention the huge open world you can explore, it's breathtaking scenery is absolutely fabulous and the map features dozens of lively locations that don't just make the world feel lived in—it makes it feel alive.

Was Genuinely looking forward to this game, im all for the memes. I was so excited to survive on The Big Steins Island escaping Tripple T. However the game is Genuinely unplayable. All the negative reviews are 100% right, and all the positive reviews are either bots, or just for the LOLs bc the game just isn't playable. Tung Tung has Snipper range and sonic speed, you have almost no sprint, you run out of sprint in literal seconds. There's nowhere to hide where you can be safe, once T sees you, you're just dead. Your only Means of defending yourself is to Shock him with the flashlight and it just doesnt work. When you shock him, he STILL hits you, falls down for a SECOND then is immediately chasing you again. He hears everything and is always around so your forced to constantly crouch and keep your light off bc it will alert him so 90% of the game is Crouching and walking aimlessly and even that doesn't guarantee your safety. Thats just the tip of the iceberg. The Key you need to get to make progress, if you grab it but then die, the next game the key is just gone. You have to completely restart the whole game and reopen it to fix it. Everytime you die, you have to watch the opening cutscene again with no way to skip it, and trust me, youre going to die a lot. i streamed the whole thing over on YT @ExtraSharpGamez -You can see at the start i was genuinely excited to play it but slowly grew more frustrated (till me stream cut out cuz wifi issues, which i then Refunded the game off stream) Its Not worth it, and this is coming from a D1 tripple T fan. This game is a sorry excuse of a game and is a total let down and shameful to the Tripple T name.

I am completely and utterly obsessed with Triple T, and I refuse to apologize for it. There is an unmatched chemical rush that hits my brain the second that chaotic, high energy techno beat drops and Triple T starts aggressively hitting his dance moves. Watching an anthropomorphic wooden stickman holding a baseball bat bust out the "Pega Pega" dance with absolute, unearned confidence fuels my love, and it has permanently altered my brain. It is the ultimate dopamine injector, nothing clears my mind quite like the Italian Brainrot multiverse. My love for triple t goes way beyond just casually watching the videos it has become a core part of my daily routine and inner monologue. I constantly find myself humming the "Tung Tung" remix under my breath, and my camera roll is slowly being overtaken by green screen templates of the Nike shark and the bomber-plane crocodile. There is a strange, beautiful community in sharing something so objectively absurd with millions of other people who also find joy in a dancing wooden creature. It is loud, it makes absolutely no sense, and that is exactly why I love it; triple t has made me happier than i ever have been in years. There are very few things in life that can truly be described as life-changing, but for me, Tung Tung Tung Sahur is one of them. Before I discovered it, my days felt ordinary and predictable. Then, one day, I heard those unforgettable words: "Tung Tung Tung Sahur." From that moment on, everything changed. It wasn't just a funny meme or a catchy sound it became a source of endless joy. Whenever I hear it, I can't help but smile. It reminds me that happiness can come from the most unexpected places, and that's something I carry with me every day. My appreciation for Tung Tung Tung Sahur grew even stronger when I discovered Tung Tung Tung Survival on Steam. The game perfectly captures Triple T. In conclusion, I will always be grateful that Tung Tung Tung Sahur entered my life. What started as a simple meme became something that consistently makes me laugh and gives me great memories with friends. Tung Tung Tung Survival expanded that experience by turning the meme into an interactive adventure that I can enjoy again and again. Some people may never understand the greatness of Tung Tung Tung Sahur, but that's okay. I know in my heart that it is one of the greatest creations of the internet, and I will proudly continue spreading the joy of Tung Tung Tung Sahur for many years to come. PS. Seeing the golden Triple T after buying the supporter pack genuinely made me hard, I love you Triple T. Thank you for this.

The graphics and audio are beyond anything I've ever experienced in a video game. The moment I booted it up, I had an instant eargasm and genuinely started crying because of how unbelievably stunning it was. The gameplay and storytelling are ten times better than Red Dead Redemption 2, Disco Elysium, The Witcher 3, and The Last of Us Part I combined. This game is a 10/10 and an instant cult classic. If I had the power to change reality, I would erase my memory just so I could experience it for the first time all over again.

This GTA 6 has nothing on this game. This game is a generation classic hit and will never be replicated. To start, this game has an amazing campaign and story to go with it. YOU are stuck on the big T's island and now having to escape by fixing the boat that crashed. NEVER BEFORE have I seen such a game with a compelling story. Next we have to address the fact that this game is addictive is a great way. I will replay the game every morning well before the sun is even up and I will even ignore taking care of my family because of how fun this game is. My 3 year old son hasn't been fed in weeks because of good this game is. I don't even want to do anything outside of this game apart from watch videos on yt about it. Triple T chasing after you with the fog is what by far what makes this game the most scariest game you can ever play. This game makes Poppy Playtime look like a kids game rated E for everyone when stacked against this. After that, we have to talk about graphics, this game looks amazing on windows. Tung Tung Tung Survival's graphics look like they are as good as RDR2's graphics and maybe even better. The grass and trees look amazing and atmospheric with the fog. The fog is what really makes the graphics and game look amazing. There are almost no games that compete with Tung Tung Tung Survival's graphics. And that's not even mention how great the terrain looks. The hills and beaches are blended in so well you really can't tell the difference between this and real life with the graphics and terrain formation. Lastly we have to talk about what is to expect after this game. like I said earlier, GTA 6 will not even come close to this masterpiece. Every triple A title will have to wonder how well their game will stand against this one. Tung Tung Tung Survival is single handedly the only game that deserves to be Game of the Year and it will easily win this year. Every game after this will have to hold the same quality and greatness of this game All in all, this game is worth every dollar they charge it for. This game will be looked back on when I am a grandpa and will be known as the best game of the century. It will take maybe another 67 years before we can ever get a game this good again. So will you purchase this and tell your grandkids what peak 'Tung Tung Tung Survival' was like?

"He hears the island. He hears you." If you told me last week that I’d be crouching in a bush at 2:00 AM while a giant wooden drum monster hunts me down across a 1km × 1km island, I would’ve called you crazy. Yet, here I am, absolutely hooked. The Good Pure Suspense: The stealth mechanics hit the sweet spot between absurdity and genuinely terrifying atmosphere. One snapped twig or misplaced step, and the footfalls start coming for you fast. Simple but Effective Gameplay Loop: Scavenging for boat parts across the island feels rewarding, especially when every resource run carries genuine risk. Meme Power: Turning a viral AI meme into an actual full-blown survival horror experience works way better than it has any right to
